e3vh96t1s22o.speaker: channa
e3vh96t1s22o.text: Heh heh. So our cow’s dung is crossing the sea too!
e3vh96t1s22o.heard: Heh heh. So our cow’s dung is crossing the sea too!
e3vh96t1s22o.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1xie60q1iist.speaker: mei
e1xie60q1iist.text: Channa! The way you put things!
e1xie60q1iist.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1vsdjnytcm84.speaker: narr
e1vsdjnytcm84.text: Mei and Channa looked at each other and burst out laughing.
e1vsdjnytcm84.heard: Mei and Channa looked at each other and burst out laughing.
e1vsdjnytcm84.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

etpw9w7jiiac.speaker: mei
etpw9w7jiiac.text: Hey, traveller. Tomorrow we’re putting up a new post. Channa and I are going to plant a cutting.
etpw9w7jiiac.heard: Tomorrow we’re putting up a new post. Channa and I are going to plant a cutting.
etpw9w7jiiac.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1t4dmmpnayv9.speaker: mei
e1t4dmmpnayv9.text: With pepper, it takes years after you plant it before it gives proper fruit.
e1t4dmmpnayv9.heard: With pepper, it takes years after you plant it before it gives proper fruit.
e1t4dmmpnayv9.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ekvccv9h9ztd.speaker: channa
ekvccv9h9ztd.text: So that post is “our post”. By the time we’re grown up, the vine should reach all the way to the top.
ekvccv9h9ztd.heard: So that post is our post. By the time we're grown up, the vine should reach all the way to the top.
ekvccv9h9ztd.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e12mlykx1tnpk.speaker: mei
e12mlykx1tnpk.text: Yeah! We’ll make it the hottest one!
e12mlykx1tnpk.heard: Yeah, we'll make it the hottest one.
e12mlykx1tnpk.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e157451v9m23c.speaker: channa
e157451v9m23c.text: …E-even if we fight, there’s still only one post.
e157451v9m23c.heard: E-even if we fight, there’s still only one post.
e157451v9m23c.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e26468g1uwgm.speaker: nekmax
e26468g1uwgm.text: …We’re back. A Kampot pepper farm in 2026.
e26468g1uwgm.heard: We're back, a KEMPOT pepper farm in 2026.
e26468g1uwgm.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eembdjvu08ex.speaker: nekmax
eembdjvu08ex.text: Look. At the foot of the limestone hills, pepper posts stand in rows again.
eembdjvu08ex.heard: Look. At the foot of the limestone hills, pepper posts stand in rows again.
eembdjvu08ex.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eyk51so48xvc.speaker: nekmax
eyk51so48xvc.text: …But this farm went through a long, empty time.
eyk51so48xvc.heard: But this farm went through a long, empty time.
eyk51so48xvc.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

etgoxwyzyxkg.speaker: nekmax
etgoxwyzyxkg.text: In the 1970s, Cambodia went through a long war and the years of the Pol Pot regime. Many, many people died, and many were separated from their families.
etgoxwyzyxkg.heard: In the 1970s, Cambodia went through a long war and the years of the Pol Pot regime. Many, many people died, and many were separated
etgoxwyzyxkg.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

ebgr32a1uwxo.speaker: nekmax
ebgr32a1uwxo.text: No one could look after the fields, and pepper growing in Kampot almost stopped.
ebgr32a1uwxo.heard: No one could look after the fields, and pepper growing in Kampot almost stopped.
ebgr32a1uwxo.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

esv68t9164az.speaker: nekmax
esv68t9164az.text: Mei and Channa are children made up for this story. But the children of those days really had to live through that time.
esv68t9164az.heard: Mei and Channa are children made up for this story. But the children of those days really had to live through
esv68t9164az.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1t2xni33szvq.speaker: nekmax
e1t2xni33szvq.text: From around 1998, when the fighting was over and the country slowly grew calmer, farmers began growing pepper again.
e1t2xni33szvq.heard: From around 1998, when the fighting was over and the country slowly grew calmer, farmers began growing pepper again.
e1t2xni33szvq.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eoqbgq8mcz6y.speaker: nekmax
eoqbgq8mcz6y.text: Putting up one post at a time, planting one cutting at a time.
eoqbgq8mcz6y.heard: Putting up one post at a time, planting one cutting at a time.
eoqbgq8mcz6y.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1tqxpwie8wk7.speaker: nekmax
e1tqxpwie8wk7.text: In 2010, Kampot pepper became Cambodia’s first “Geographical Indication”. It’s a mark that only pepper grown here, in the agreed way, may be called “Kampot pepper”.
e1tqxpwie8wk7.heard: In 2010, Kampot pepper became Cambodia’s first “Geographical Indication”. It’s a mark that only pepper grown here, in the agreed way, may be called “Kampot pepper”.
e1tqxpwie8wk7.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e78dg0y1jnul.speaker: nekmax
e78dg0y1jnul.text: In 2016, the same kind of mark was recognised in Europe too. It was the first time for anything from Cambodia.
e78dg0y1jnul.heard: In 2016, the same kind of mark was recognised in Europe too. It was the first time for anything
e78dg0y1jnul.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eidhs4x1llfb.speaker: nekmax
eidhs4x1llfb.text: Even so, around 2020 the harvest was about 80 tonnes a year. That’s still very far from the 3,000 tonnes of the old days.
eidhs4x1llfb.heard: Even so, around 2020 the harvest was about 80 tonnes a year. That’s still very far from the 3,000 tonnes of the old days.
eidhs4x1llfb.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

ejrnsnd194l7.speaker: nekmax
ejrnsnd194l7.text: Not everything came back. …But the posts are standing again.
ejrnsnd194l7.heard: Not everything came back. …But the posts are standing again.
ejrnsnd194l7.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1paqqna1ooxe.speaker: nekmax
e1paqqna1ooxe.text: There’s also a person who came from Japan and, since the 1990s, has helped rebuild Cambodian pepper growing in another province.
e1paqqna1ooxe.heard: There’s also a person who came from Japan and, since the 1990s, has helped rebuild Cambodian pepper growing in another province.
e1paqqna1ooxe.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1892nj5ojm2i.speaker: nekmax
e1892nj5ojm2i.text: They say many descendants of the families who came from Hainan are still growing pepper around here today.
e1892nj5ojm2i.heard: They say many descendants of the families who came from Hainan are still growing pepper around
e1892nj5ojm2i.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e9kjnk71g04c.speaker: nekmax
e9kjnk71g04c.text: (whispering) Some farms let you taste fresh green pepper. …Your face might turn red again.
e9kjnk71g04c.heard: Some farms let you taste fresh green pepper. Your face might turn red again.
e9kjnk71g04c.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eepjhivwbd98.speaker: nekmax

eepjhivwbd98.heard: Do you remember the sweet smell of red pepper? Shops in town sell red pepper too.
eepjhivwbd98.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

ec15yqy190xn.heard: At the crab market in the nearby town of Kep, fresh crab stir-fried with Kampot pepper is a famous dish.
ec15yqy190xn.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

esn3dd31y9tv.speaker: nekmax

e1hw25sa1g2ad.speaker: nekmax

e1q23qgk1xdkq.speaker: narr
e1q23qgk1xdkq.text: Mitsu picked a bright red-orange persimmon from the tree in the yard. With the little knife, Genzō peeled it smoothly.
e1q23qgk1xdkq.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ehxe3phi7xog.speaker: narr
ehxe3phi7xog.text: The peel came off in one long ribbon, curling down and down without ever breaking.
ehxe3phi7xog.heard: The peel came off in one long ribbon, curling down and down without ever breaking.
ehxe3phi7xog.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e7yffdk1k99k.speaker: mitsu
e7yffdk1k99k.text: Wow…! It didn't break! Not even once!
e7yffdk1k99k.heard: It didn't break! Not even once!
e7yffdk1k99k.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1uq6d1se5dv2.speaker: mitsu
e1uq6d1se5dv2.text: Hey, traveller. If you had this knife, what would you use it for?
e1uq6d1se5dv2.heard: Hey, traveller. If you had this knife, what would you use it for?

e190uwy21x6wj.speaker: mitsu
